n: Moroni preserves the words Jesus spoke to the twelve Nephite disciples while laying his hands on each of them. Touch and authority go together: priesthood power is passed on by the laying on of hands.

f.w: the twelve whom he had chosen
as he laid his hands upon them

n: Jesus called each disciple by name and taught them to pray mightily to the Father in his name, after which they could give the gift of the Holy Ghost by the laying on of hands. He notes that his apostles in Jerusalem did the same.

f.g: earnest, wholehearted prayer — not a casual or routine request.

f.w: ye shall give the Holy Ghost

n: This instruction came during Christ’s first visit to the Nephites, spoken privately to the disciples rather than the crowd. Afterward, everyone they laid hands on received the Holy Ghost, showing the promise was fulfilled.
